fire: If you get seasick, take a pill such as meclizine before boarding.
For a mild headache, a painkiller like acetaminophen usually helps.
Peppermint oil may relieve bloating and stomach cramps.
For hay fever, an antihistamine such as loratadine works well.
Lying still in a dark room can ease vertigo and nausea.
Keep an antacid like Tums handy for heartburn at night.
Warm compresses can soothe muscle cramps after a long run.
For travel nausea, many people use a remedy such as ginger capsules.
quiet: If you get bored, take a book such as a mystery before boarding.
For a long drive, a playlist like classic rock usually helps.
Peppermint tea may be served after dinner at the inn.
For hiking, a jacket such as a light shell works well.
Lying still in a dark room is a good way to watch the stars.
Keep a charger like an Anker pack handy for long flights.
Warm blankets can be found in the closet by the door.
For travel, many people use a bag such as a small backpack.
